annotations.title: Add text to the knowledge base

description: Add a titled block of text to one website's knowledge base. The chatbot can use it in answers as soon as this returns. Adds a new entry; it never replaces an existing one.

content.description: The text itself. At least 10 characters.

title.description: Short name for this entry, shown in the dashboard.

website_id.description: Numeric id of the website, from list_websites. Omit to use the account's primary website.

name: add_knowledge_text
title: Add text to the knowledge base
